description: Business entities and rules as plain code (`createOrder`), independent of React, HTTP and storage.
One user intention (`placeOrder`) that orchestrates the domain and reaches the outside world only through ports.
An interface the application needs, described in its own terms: `orderGateway.save(order) → { id }`.
A technology-specific implementation of a port (HTTP, localStorage, in-memory) or a driver of the application (a React component).
The single place that creates concrete adapters and injects them into use cases and the UI, usually `App.jsx` or `main.jsx`.
Source dependencies point inward: adapters → application → domain. The domain imports nothing from outer rings.
